task.title: Ignore NUL-bearing SSE event fields
task.objective: Ignore invalid event fields containing U+0000 while retaining event data and valid parser state
acceptance_criteria: A NUL-bearing event field does not replace the current event identity
An event with no prior valid identity still dispatches as message
Delivered data counts normally and following events remain independent

attempts.summary: Exercised default, prior-identity, following-event, and event-count behavior
attempts.diagnostic: Whole-event rejection dropped events that should have retained the default or prior valid identity

attempts.summary: Moved NUL rejection from completed-event dispatch to event-field consumption

outcome.summary: NUL-bearing event fields are ignored without discarding valid event data or disturbing event accounting

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1094

lessons: Reject malformed protocol fields at field consumption rather than dropping otherwise valid records
Ignoring an invalid state update preserves the prior valid identity and default behavior
